subject: pri-info-td
title: PRI.INFO.TD.------ALT.F.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-18, on the page where Braxton argues that 'creativity is related to functionalism, both with regards to the meta-reality of a given culture group and the actualness of particulars on the physical universe level.' (C)PRI-INFO-TD (principle information tendencies) is crossed with ALT-F (alternative functionalism). Besides the main line to ALT-F, two branches leave the subject. INFO-DY (information dynamics) carries INFO-CON (information convergence) → IST-P. AFI (affinity insight) carries RE-ST (restructuralism) → SOC-RT (social reality), which branches to RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and to FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics).
